data.title: Athlon
data.about:
Welcome to Athlon by Aldar, Dubai’s newest landmark development in Dubailand, redefining the essence of active living. This pioneering project, a collaboration between Aldar and Dubai Holding, now features an exciting partnership with Manchester City, enhancing its appeal.

Athlon in Dubailand offers 1,492 units, including spacious 3 to 6 bedroom villas and townhouses. Athlon by Aldar is Dubai’s premier community focused on physical fitness and wellness, implementing active design principles by top health experts to weave movement into the fabric of everyday life. This fosters a long-lasting health-conscious environment for its residents. 

Within Athlon, residents can enjoy extensive walking and cycling trails, mingled with vibrant green parks, fostering a harmonious balance between activity and tranquility. This marks Athlon’s first foray as Aldar’s master community project in Dubai, showcasing their deep experience from Abu Dhabi in crafting expansive, integrated living spaces.

characteristics_module.title: Active Living Redefined at Athlon Townhouses & Villas
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Expert-Designed Community Engagement at Athlon: Activities and spaces are expertly tailored to enhance communication and interaction among residents, fostering a robust community bond.
  • Health and Wellness Oversight by Athlon by Aldar: Supervised by renowned physical health and fitness experts to ensure the long-term well-being of those at Athlon Townhouses & Villas.
  • Central Park and Themed Parks in Athlon Dubailand: Features a large central park and four thematic parks (Adventure Play, Fitness, and a valley), offering diverse recreational opportunities.
  • Multipurpose Clubs at Athlon: Home to seven clubs, providing varied social and recreational facilities to cater to all ages and interests within Athlon by Aldar.
  • Fitness Social Events Aligned with Manchester City: Regular fitness and social events promote an active lifestyle and greater community participation, in line with the Athlon Manchester City collaboration.

location_tile.title: Reside in an Active Community at Dubailand
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Situated next to Arabian Ranches 3, Athlon by Aldar, home to the exclusive Athlon Townhouses & Villas, stands prominently between Sheikh Zayed Bin Maktoum Al Nahyan Street (D54) and Emirates Road. This distinguished residential project is set to elevate living experiences in Dubai. Located in close proximity to the vibrant Global Village, Athlon provides seamless connectivity to both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International airports, each just a 30-minute drive away. Experience the essence of Dubailand with Athlon, proudly associated with Manchester City, where luxury meets convenience.

  • 20 minutes to Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai Hills Mall & Dubai Hills Golf course
  • 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 30 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 35 minutes to Downtown Dubai & Dubai Mall
